orders.text:
(Stay Appl. No.1077 of 2017) 
In 
CRLR No.181 of 2017 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
 
 Mr. Girish Chandra Lakhchaura, 
Advocate for the revisionist. 
 Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, AGA for the 
State of Uttarakhand/respondent no.3. 
 Heard. 
 Admit. 
 Issue notice to the private 
respondent. 
 List on 21.08.2017. 
Also heard on the stay application. 
 It is stated by the counsel for the 
applicant that the applicant is seriously 
interested in amicable settlement and will 
take his wife and daughter with him. 
 It is directed that execution of the 
impugned judgment and order dated 
30.03.2017 passed by Judge, Family 
Court, Nainital (Camp Court Ramnagar), in 
Misc. Criminal Case No.43 of 2014 shall 
remain stayed provided revisionist deposits 
`2,500/- to the respondent no.1 and 
`1,000/- to respondent no.2 on or before 
10th of every month. Revisionist is 
permitted to deposit the amount of arrears 
within one year in six equal installments. 
 Stay application stands disposed of. 
 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 07.07.2017
